status: declared by the pull request that closes #544 before any score was computed; nothing here is tuned on a scored day; the choices below (the design, the source labels, the source weight, the prior, the combination with the risk-date passer) are the pull request's, listed there for Eleonora's review

design.estimator: a ridge logistic of spread > tau (ml.PRESSURE_LOGISTIC_SETTINGS: L2, C = 1, standardised), one per threshold, the logistic form of risk_logistic, on every day
design.left_out: the Treasury settlement columns and every input built after 2018 (the SOFR percentiles, ON RRP, the daily TGA): the pre-2018 history does not carry them, so the two markets share one design
design.pairs: the direct pairs of every training day (ml._pressure_pairs); the source's pairs are built by effr_history.history_pairs with the same design, each label paired with what was public at its own decision instant, both under the as-of rule and its independent check

source.role: training data only; no pre-2018 row is ever scored
source.caveat: the fed funds series is the unsecured market and SOFR is secured Treasury repo: only the pattern transfers
source.threshold_rule: for each SOFR threshold the whole-basis-point source threshold whose share of source rows strictly above it is closest to the share of the published panel's days before 2026-01-01 strictly above the SOFR threshold (a tie to the higher one; only thresholds below the highest source print are tried): scripts/effr_pretrain.py derive_source_thresholds, re-derived by `run`, which refuses other numbers. Fed funds traded below IOER throughout, so the +5 bp event does not exist in the source

effr_pooled.rule: (a) one fit on the SOFR pairs (weight 1) and the source pairs (weight source_weight), with a source indicator as the design's last column (0 on every served row); columns standardised on the SOFR pairs alone
effr_pooled.why_this_weight: stated, not tuned: one source row counts a quarter of a SOFR row

effr_pretrain_finetune.rule: (b) a ridge logistic on the source pairs alone; then the SOFR-era refit, walk-forward, whose L2 penalty is centred on the pre-trained slopes (converted between the two standardisations through raw units) with the same C = 1 and a free intercept. A threshold whose source labels hold one class has no prior (the SOFR-era fit). A refit whose SOFR window holds one class is served the pre-trained model: the source thresholds are rate-matched, so its intercept is a base rate

effr_sofr_only.rule: the parent: the same design and estimator on the SOFR-era pairs alone (ml.pressure_logistic_exceedance), no source rows

combined.rule: the rule of #506: on a risk date (metadata/risk_date_severity.json) the passer's forecast, unchanged; on any other day the transfer model's. The hurdle of #539 is not used: its code had not merged. Both transfer variants and the control are combined, so the row is not chosen on a score

cutoffs: the judge's cutoff_rule, from each model's own training window; one cut-off per threshold and horizon
judging: the judge as declared (metadata/pressure_judge.json): tiers 1, 3 and 5, h = 1 to 5, +5 and +10 bp, under the flat and the weighted rule; the cut-off rule unchanged
published: nothing: the models and the source are off in every published declaration
